summary: #93917 remains a reproducible, narrow bug on current main (8a4da1d19fadb839d59bd581e8b2403460c873c9). Failed exec outcomes currently hash changing text/aggregated output, so their no-progress streak resets and the existing regression test expects only a warning after 30 calls. A new focused PR should use the stable failed-exec facts while retaining output-sensitive hashing for completed exec calls. The read-only checkout prevents applying or running the repair here; the executable fix artifact is ready for the deterministic executor.
